quality.review_scope: Actual source-first text and original-page visual reading of all 8 main pages. missing_fields: Main article pages1-8 are the eligible source scope. Matching local SI exists but its strict-screen decision is no_target_recipe and no positive source-specific resolution was found; SI remains unread/excluded. External cited methods are not imported.

No source-curve digitization, atom model or unreported chemical/particle/film geometry is reconstructed.
